d: Ukraine has carried out a major drone attack on two Russian ships docked at Libya's Benghazi port, nearly 1,600 kilometres from Ukrainian territory. According to reports, multiple drones targeted the Russian Navy warship Mercury during the night of November 22–23. While some drones were intercepted, two reportedly struck the vessel, triggering a massive explosion and fire before the warship sank. Hours later, another Russian vessel, the cargo ship MV Angara, was also targeted at the same port. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has claimed responsibility for both attacks. The strikes…
